name: Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle
summary:
Explore, battle and grow stronger. A classic Dragon Quest adventure, designed for your smartphone.

Wander far and wide, take on the monsters in your path and put your tactics to the test in turn-based battles. Make clever use of Fast Strike and pep powers, and bring home the spoils to help your base flourish.

Make your own way through the tale, with fresh discoveries linking one adventure to the next.
A world of RPG wonder, right at your fingertips.
